title: deployment test
body: Hello, during the deployment test, I noticed that there is only information about the audio stream. Currently, is video stream not supported? Do I need to perform any special processing? Also, regarding the data source type, currently it processes data of a single modality. Does it support simultaneous input of both audio and video streams? Is there a way to debug the code using a single thread?
author: 421212-huv

comments.body: Please refer to our latest update, the video input is added. However, when feed video into the MiniCPM model, the VRAM requirements will increase, which may cause oom on 24GB device. Or you can try the openai-compatible config, it can be set to use qwen-vl and provide response according to the last image before human speech end.

I reviewed your video frame processing method and noticed that the final input to the API model is in image format. Is this image a single frame from the video? Can I convert it into a video file (.mp4)? If possible, where would you recommend performing this conversion? Looking forward to your reply. Thank you!

Since video input comes from the camera of client, video stream is sent via rtc. By default, rtc stream is decoded into rgb frame series, so they are converted to a list of PIL images, this is the requested input type of multi modal model. You can dump theses images anywhere here, but dump to mp4 file from raw rga data involves encoding, which will consume additional computation power. The best dump way maybe directly get the raw video stream packet and just mux them into mp4 container, however, we have not exposed this routine.
